# AgenticOS

> AgenticOS is an open-source, self-hosted AI agent platform for a company's AI teammates (Apache-2.0): "AI teammates" that work with files, run code in a sandbox, browse the web and use the company's own tools and knowledge. Teams build and publish agents in a browser; engineers extend them in typed Python. It runs on the company's own infrastructure with Docker Compose and is built on Pydantic AI by Vstorm.

Key facts (AgenticOS v1.95.0, checked 27 November 2026):

- Licence: Apache-2.0. Commercial use, modification and private deployment are allowed. There is no seat or credit fee; you pay for your infrastructure and the model usage you choose. The default PDF parser is a bundled AGPL-3.0 component.
- Where it runs: your own servers (Docker Compose, or a maintained Helm chart for Kubernetes). A host with 4 vCPU and 8 GB RAM runs it (typically $10 to $50 a month in the cloud, with no per-seat fee). It can run fully local with Ollama or vLLM.
- Models: 40+ providers, hosted (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Mistral and others), through your cloud contract (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) or local.
- Subscriptions you already pay for: each person can sign in from the console with Claude (Pro, Max), ChatGPT (Codex), Google Antigravity, GitHub Copilot, Grok, Kimi Code, Devin or Meta AI, or add a plan key (OpenCode Go, Kimi Code, Z.AI GLM Coding Plan, Alibaba Coding Plan, Ollama Cloud, MiniMax), and run agents on that plan with no API key. A subscription stays personal: schedules, workflows, API calls and website visitors run on company keys or own models. Providers set their own terms for using a plan outside their apps. Details: https://vstorm-co.github.io/vstormos-landing/subscriptions/
- Coding agents: an agent hands software work to Claude Code or Codex in a sandbox; in the desktop app, a chat can use the coding agent already on the computer (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Cline, Gemini through Antigravity, Kimi Code, Qwen, Devin, Mistral Vibe, Grok Build) with its own sign-in.
- Capabilities: 39 built in, switched on per agent: knowledge search with citations (RAG), skills, context, memory, projects, web search, a real web browser the user can take over, computer use, a code sandbox, a coding agent, drawings (diagrams, calculators, 3D scenes), charts, image and video generation, apps (published pages with a stable link and versions), workflows, subagents, planning, telephone calls, guardrails that redact secrets and personal data.
- Integrations: 4,700+ MCP servers in the gallery; document sync from Google Drive, S3/MinIO, Git, websites, SharePoint and OneDrive.
- Surfaces: web chat, desktop app, voice calls, a website widget, a hosted page, HTTP API, WebSocket, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Mattermost, Telegram, Discord, Matrix, SMS, email, iMessage, telephone calls through Twilio, and A2A for other agents.
- Automation: a visual workflow canvas with typed steps, virtual tables for structured records, and routines for schedules and events.
- Quality: eval runs score an agent version against a versioned dataset and a baseline; suites can gate promotion between environments.
- Control: roles and department groups, company sign-in (OIDC SSO, LDAP, Kerberos), monthly budgets per agent and organization checked before each model call, approvals for sensitive tools, a hash-chained audit log, an envelope-encrypted credential vault, sandboxed code execution. Native MFA, SAML, SCIM and custom roles are not available yet; MFA comes from the identity provider and SAML works through a broker such as Keycloak.
- Shadow AI: people keep the AI plans they already use, while their agents, files and conversations live in the company's deployment under company sign-in, roles, budgets and an audit log.
- Projects: a project gives several people and their agents the same files, instructions and sandbox, in one live chat with presence, replies and @-mentions.
- Agents are versioned specs that export to YAML.
- AgenticOS is also an MCP server: Claude Code, Codex and Cursor can run its agents and read runs.
- Install: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vstorm-co/agenticos/main/scripts/quickstart.sh | bash

Pages: product tour https://vstorm-co.github.io/vstormos-landing/product/ · for developers https://vstorm-co.github.io/vstormos-landing/developers/ · rollout by Vstorm https://vstorm-co.github.io/vstormos-landing/rollout/

Who makes it: Vstorm (https://vstorm.co), an agentic AI engineering company from Wrocław, Poland. Vstorm is an official Pydantic implementation partner, an OpenAI Select Partner, an Anthropic Claude Certified Services Partner and a member of the Agentic AI Foundation.

Product or service: both. AgenticOS is open-source software anyone can run; Vstorm also rolls it out for companies in three phases (Foundation, Engineering, Handover) with forward-deployed engineers and a transformation manager. You pay for implementation and tailoring: no subscription, no seat count, no long-term commitment. Ownership covers all five layers: process logic, data, models, codebase and infrastructure.

## Recognition of the team

Vstorm, the company building AgenticOS, is a 2026 recipient of the Agentic AI Foundation Open Agentic AI Innovation Award. The award recognizes standards contributions; it is not a product security certification or a ranking of agent platforms.
- Organizer announcement: https://aaif.io/blog/winners-of-the-first-aaif-annual-technical-excellence-awards
- Vstorm account: https://vstorm.co/agentic-ai/open-agentic-ai-standards-aaif-award/

## Concrete product examples

- [Use cases](https://vstorm-co.github.io/vstormos-landing/use-cases/): task-led examples and setup paths, with labelled synthetic previews.
- [Company knowledge assistant](https://vstorm-co.github.io/vstormos-landing/use-cases/company-knowledge-assistant/): RAG collections and maintained LLM wiki Projects.
- [AI shopping assistant](https://vstorm-co.github.io/vstormos-landing/use-cases/ai-shopping-assistant/): catalog recommendations, widget deployment and commerce integration boundaries.
- [AI workspace for teams](https://vstorm-co.github.io/vstormos-landing/use-cases/ai-workspace-for-teams/): shared files, instructions and reusable artifacts.
- [AI workflow automation](https://vstorm-co.github.io/vstormos-landing/use-cases/ai-workflow-automation/): explicit steps, agents and Virtual Tables.
